info.title: Menkakusitsu API
info.description: All registered REST operations. Request schemas describe canonical parsed values; numeric and true/false strings are also accepted where the runtime schemas coerce them. Failures use HTTP 4xx/5xx and an HttpError body.

delete.description: Students may delete themselves. Selecting another account requires Teacher permission.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Protection
parameters.description: Requires an Origin matching WEB_PREFIX. Browsers must include credentials. Refresh tokens are only returned through an HttpOnly cookie.

put.description: Not implemented: valid requests return HTTP 501 with code PASSWORD_RESET_UNAVAILABLE. No reset or email is performed.
Only the author or a developer may update the post.

delete.description: Only the author or a developer may delete the post.
Only the comment author or a developer may delete it.

get.description: Cached external meal data: tomorrow's breakfast and today's lunch and dinner in Asia/Seoul. No date parameter.
Anonymous requests receive masked names. If a token is supplied, it must be a valid access token.
Currently public; when is a YYYY-MM-DD date.

put.description: Currently public. Path date takes precedence over the required body date.
The success response returns the updated password digest as newPassword.

accessToken.description: Access token returned by login or refresh.

refreshCookie.name: menkakusitsu-refresh
refreshCookie.description: Rotating HttpOnly refresh cookie; not available in response JSON or JavaScript.

sid.description: Login session ID; not the student number

permission.description: Permission threshold; see PermissionValues. Higher values include lower permissions.

installationId.description: Only remove this FID; omitted for explicit device logout or disable.

pushToken.description: Legacy FCM token; use installationId for new clients.

PutPushRequest.description: Provide deviceId and exactly one of installationId or legacy pushToken.
